children: CAE USA, a subsidiary of CAE
from the U.S. Air Force (USAF) to continue providing training services for the C-130H Aircrew Training System (ATS).
The contract extends CAE's prime contractor role through December 2035, building on a partnership that began with its initial award in 2018.

Under the nine-year extension, CAE will deliver full-scope instruction, program management, logistics, maintenance, cybersecurity, and hardware upgrades across nine C-130H full-mission simulators and over 45 training devices nationwide.

Services will support Air Force Reserve and Air National Guard personnel, centered at the Little Rock Air Force Base Formal Training Unit in Arkansas, alongside key sites at Dobbins Air Reserve Base (Georgia), Wyoming Air National Guard Base, Minneapolis Air National Guard Base (Minnesota), and St. Joseph Air National Guard Base (Missouri).
The training suite prepares C-130H pilots, flight engineers, navigators, and loadmasters for deployment readiness.

title: CAE USA secures $300M USAF contract extension for C-130H Aircrew Training System
